name: save-boot-6-party-tifa-battle
description: #101: party slot 2's current HP is the value a battle lowers. Boot from the generated save harness/saves/disc1-md1stin-tifa.json (party Cloud, Barret, Tifa; author-chosen, to see slot 2 with a character in it). Load as save-boot-1-load does: from the title, Circle every 30 frames until field mode, then #77's field-loaded rule; the field is md1stin (116). Hold Up+Left (59 of every 60 frames) until g_GameState reads battle (2; battle_wait): up-left leaves md1stin for md1_1 (#77), where #78's attempt 3 met a random battle. 600 frames for the battle to start, then at the mark: partyID[2] and g_ActiveCharacters[2].id read Tifa (0x02; a2_tifa) and its current HP is in 1..9999 (hp2_ok). Then 3000 frames with no input (the enemies attack; nobody acts): g_ActiveCharacters[2].hp decreases since the mark (hp2_dir -1) while max HP is unchanged (max2_dir 0), and the battle is still on. Signs and 1/0 only; no HP leaves. map_cur: the field the battle started from. match: a rerun from the title snapshot ends in the same state. Slot 2 is the same layout one stride on; this scenario is the evidence for partySlot2 and partyHp2 holding a character.
